prose:
A Techmeme excerpt attributes to the Financial Times a plan for the EU to mobilize up to EUR 50 billion through a Sovereign Tech Equity Fund. The reported aim is long-term, high-risk equity investment in European AI and quantum computing businesses to support technological independence.

The Financial Times page timed out, so this summary relies on the feed excerpt rather than a readable full article or an official fund document. Up to EUR 50 billion is a reported mobilization ceiling, not evidence that the amount has been appropriated, raised or disbursed. Fund structure, eligibility, investment timetable and approval status remain unverified.
highlights: Report is attributed to unnamed FT sources
Amount is an up-to mobilization figure
Proposed investments concern AI and quantum computing
Equity stakes differ from grants or immediate payouts
Full article was not readable in this pass
No official mandate or disbursement was verified
